newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIAN BROKERS SEE MIXED MARKET, TURNOVER MAY GROW.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIAN BROKERS SEE MIXED MARKET, TURNOVER MAY GROW.

text.p: Brokers said stocks were mixed on Friday after morning trading but were optimistic about several individual shares like Hermis Bank, which recovered to 180 litas from 175.90 litas.
"The market's better than yesterday in terms of turnover," said Grazhina Bachiuliene, a broker with Vilfima. "Prices won't fall so much."
Lithuanian Gas eased to 1.75 litas from 1.79 litas. Sema dropped to 5.90 litas from 6.25 litas.
"I'd watch Sema closely with hopes that the stock will recover to 6.50 litas," Kupshys said.
Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company (LISCO) advanced to 6.50 litas from 6.40 litas. Ekranas inched up to 5.60 litas from 5.54 litas.
"LISCO will probably stay at this level, and I'd prefer buying it when it dips," Kupshys said. "I'd do the same with Hermis."

"The most interesting shares today are LISCO, Ekranas and Hermis Bank," Bachiuliene said. "Hermis Bank returned to 180 litas and there's quite high demand. We thought yesterday there was something strange about Hermis at 175.90 litas."
